answer: A new identity serves a probation of 8 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the ledge queue naming the grove that holds the sponsor's bond. As a result, every alias burns 8 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the nectar record shows exactly who is still on probation. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
